Tobias Mwangi-Hartley
Data Scientist

tobias.mwangihartley@example.com | +44 7700 900110 | linkedin.com/in/tmh-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Data scientist with six years of experience in analytics and data science, including more than four years as a data scientist. Experience building forecasting and customer propensity models used by business teams, with strengths in Python, statistics, experimentation and production SQL. Now moving towards machine learning engineering.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming and data: Python (pandas, scikit-learn, LightGBM, XGBoost, statsmodels), R (tidyverse, brms), SQL (BigQuery), dbt
Tools: Git, Jupyter, Looker, R Markdown
Methods: Machine learning, feature engineering, time-series forecasting, A/B testing, causal inference, Bayesian statistics

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Data Scientist | Thistlebox, meal-kit subscriptions | Feb 2022–present
- Built a weekly demand forecasting model for each recipe using LightGBM and calendar features. Used by operations to order ingredients, the model reduced forecast error (WAPE) from 23% to 14% and estimated food waste by 9%.
- Built an XGBoost churn propensity model used to target retention offers; validated uplift with a holdout.
- Write production SQL in BigQuery and maintain dbt models for the analytics layer.
- Design and analyse approximately 40 A/B tests per year for growth and product teams; built the team’s sequential testing calculator.
- Present results to leadership monthly.

Junior Data Analyst | Firth Energy Retail | Sep 2020–Jan 2022
- Conducted customer segmentation and tariff analysis using R and SQL.
- Automated monthly regulator reports with R Markdown.

EDUCATION

MSc Statistics, Distinction | University of the Lothians | 2020
Dissertation: Bayesian hierarchical models for small-area energy demand

BSc Mathematics | University of the Lothians | 2019

LANGUAGES
English (native), Swahili (conversational)

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a clear, concise, professional CV with a strong structure and good use of quantified outcomes. The Thistlebox experience is particularly effective: the forecasting result, estimated food-waste reduction, experiment volume and leadership communication all demonstrate business impact. The summary accurately presents the candidate as an experienced data scientist transitioning toward machine learning engineering. The main limitation is not poor writing but limited evidence of the end-to-end production engineering responsibilities required for this role, such as serving, monitoring, data versioning, orchestration and AI product development.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The CV is highly parseable: it uses standard section headings, simple text formatting, conventional job entries and no problematic tables, graphics or columns. Relevant searchable terms include Python, scikit-learn, LightGBM, XGBoost, SQL, BigQuery, dbt, Git, machine learning, feature engineering, forecasting and A/B testing. However, its AI-screening probability for this specific Machine Learning Engineer role is likely low to moderate because it does not contain supported evidence for model serving, monitoring, data versioning, MLOps, orchestration, AI products, language models, RAG, data ingestion or four years specifically as a machine learning engineer. These are substantive experience gaps rather than keyword-only problems. The cloud experience would be more ATS-visible if BigQuery were explicitly associated with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
critique.job_alignment_feedback: The document demonstrates a relevant quantitative education, strong Python and statistical modelling, production SQL, dbt, feature-related modelling work and measurable experience delivering models used by business teams. It aligns well with the forecasting, customer analytics and experimentation aspects of the role. The candidate's material does not show a degree in machine learning, computer science or engineering; it shows an MSc in Statistics and BSc in Mathematics, so the degree requirement is a gap against the stated wording. It also does not show at least four years as a machine learning engineer shipping ML or AI systems to production, chat assistants or RAG, model serving, monitoring, data versioning, MLOps/orchestration tools, or explicit data-ingestion pipelines. The CV provides limited evidence related to the company's AI customer-support products and limited explicit evidence of ownership, teamwork, candid feedback or learning from mistakes, although the leadership presentations and cross-functional work with operations, growth and product teams provide some relevant context.
critique.improvement_instructions:
CRITICAL / ATS visibility:
1. In the Technical Skills section, change "SQL (BigQuery), dbt" to "SQL (Google Cloud Platform (GCP) / BigQuery), dbt". This makes the existing BigQuery experience explicitly searchable as GCP experience without adding unsupported cloud tools.

MINOR / clarity:
2. In the Professional Summary, change "Experience building forecasting and customer propensity models used by business teams" to "Built and delivered forecasting and customer propensity models used by operations and retention teams". This uses the document's existing evidence and makes the model-delivery impact more specific.

3. In the Data Scientist entry under Thistlebox, change "Built an XGBoost churn propensity model used to target retention offers; validated uplift with a holdout" to "Built an XGBoost churn-propensity model used by the retention team to target offers; validated treatment uplift with a holdout analysis." This makes the business application and evaluation method clearer while remaining faithful to the original information.

4. In the same Thistlebox entry, change "Write production SQL in BigQuery and maintain dbt models for the analytics layer" to "Write production SQL in BigQuery and maintain dbt models supporting the analytics layer." This gives the existing data-engineering contribution a slightly clearer operational description without implying unsupported ingestion or orchestration experience.

At least four years as a machine learning engineer shipping ML or AI systems to production
Experience with AI products such as chat assistants or RAG
Production software engineering skills: model serving, monitoring, data versioning
Experience with AWS, GCP or Azure
